QUOTE: The four thread-spawn sites the index finds are all in `programs/` (`ssl_pthread_server.c:277`, `benchmark.c:430/444`, `ssl_server2.c:1699`). The library spawns nothing.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads, but it describes the mutex abstraction as conditional on `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`. It never says that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (threading.h/threading.c) for threaded callers to use, so the second half of the contrast is missing.
